title: Add provider profile summary-first view with Change Info + Update flow, and lock bio-data fields

requirements.text: Update the Service Provider profile experience so that, immediately after a Service Provider logs in and navigates to “My Profile” (Provider Profile page), they first see a read-only summary of their provider information (no editable inputs by default).

quotes: ENSURE THAT THE MOMENT THE SERVICE PROVIDER LOGS IN HE/SHE FIRST SEES A SUMMARY OF THE INFO

acceptanceCriteria: When the authenticated user role is Service Provider and they navigate to the Provider Profile page, the default view is a read-only summary (not an edit form).
The summary shows key provider details currently stored (at minimum: Name, Service Category, Hourly Rate, Phone Number, Description, Pinned Location, and Engagement Status).
No editable text inputs are shown in the default summary view.

requirements.text: Add a clear provider-facing action button labeled “Change Info” on the Provider Profile summary view that switches the page into an edit mode for allowed fields.

quotes: IF THEY INTEND TO ALTER ANYTHING CREATE A BUTTON TO CHANGE INFO

acceptanceCriteria: A visible button labeled “Change Info” is present on the Provider Profile summary view.
Clicking “Change Info” enters an edit mode that allows the provider to modify only allowed fields (see non-editable bio-data requirement).
There is a clear way to exit edit mode without saving (e.g., “Cancel” returns to the read-only summary and discards unsaved local changes).

requirements.text: In Provider Profile edit mode, add an explicit “Update” (or “Save Changes”) button that becomes enabled only when there are changes and persists the changes to the backend; show clear English success/error feedback.

quotes: THERE IS NO UPDATE BUTTON WHEN A SERVICE PROVIDER DOES ANY CHANGES IN THEIR PAGE

acceptanceCriteria: In edit mode, an “Update”/“Save Changes” button is visible and triggers a backend update for the edited provider fields.
The button is disabled while a save is in progress, and re-enabled afterward.
On successful save, the UI returns to the read-only summary view and shows a success message in English.
On failure, the UI stays in edit mode and shows a user-friendly English error message.
After a successful save, the Provider Profile data shown in the summary reflects the latest backend values (React Query caches are invalidated/refetched as needed).

requirements.text: Enforce that provider bio-data (identity details sourced from an ID document) is not editable in the app by making those fields read-only in both summary and edit experiences, and by enforcing the same restriction server-side so attempts to modify bio-data are ignored or rejected.

quotes: BIO DATA IS SUPPOSED TO BE PICKED FROM AN ID DOCUMENT AS IT IS THEREFORE CANNOT BE ALTERED

acceptanceCriteria: Bio-data fields are displayed as read-only and cannot be edited in the UI (even in edit mode).
Backend update logic does not allow overwriting bio-data fields for an existing provider profile (server-side enforcement).
User-facing helper text in English explains that bio-data cannot be changed because it is taken from an ID document.
This change does not break existing onboarding/profile creation flows (initial creation can still set these fields, but later updates cannot modify them).

requirements.text: Replace/remove the outdated Provider Profile copy that says profile editing will be available in a future update, and ensure the Provider Profile page messaging matches the new summary-first + Change Info + Update flow.

quotes: THERE IS NO UPDATE BUTTON WHEN A SERVICE PROVIDER DOES ANY CHANGES IN THEIR PAGE

acceptanceCriteria: The text “Note: Profile editing will be available in a future update...” is not shown on the Provider Profile page.
All user-facing guidance on the Provider Profile page is in English and accurately describes how to update allowed fields (via “Change Info” then “Update”).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in `backend/main.mo` (no additional backend services).
Only create `backend/migration.mo` if a state/schema upgrade is required by the changes.
Do not edit frontend files under `frontend/src/components/ui` or other paths listed in `frontend.immutablePaths`; compose them instead.
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Do not implement OCR/ID-document scanning or automatic extraction of bio-data from images in this change.
Do not add third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity).
Do not redesign unrelated client/back-office pages beyond what is necessary to support the provider summary/edit flow.
